sections.title: Strategic Consulting
sections.lead: Our strategic consulting services span across all of our areas of expertise: Productivity, Artificial Intelligence, Cloud, Cybersecurity, and Managed Services. The involvement of our leaders and our multidisciplinary expertise will ensure the success of your strategic projects.

sections.intro: We offer a strategic and innovative approach.

featured.title: Digital Transformation
featured.text: Our goal is to accelerate your project with tangible and measurable results.

aside.title: Multidisciplinary Team
aside.text: Our seasoned strategy and technology consultants will help you achieve your goals. Victrix offers a human approach and has at heart the well-being of its teams.

items.title: Understand
items.text: Assessment and discovery workshops, questionnaires: business, IT and users' needs, systems used, contracts, expertise, constraints, initiatives, issues, and guiding principles.

items.title: Prioritize
items.text: Scope review, policy and strategy workshops: trends, comparables, best practices, and presentation to management.

items.title: Plan
items.text: Timeframe for implementation, priorities, availability, internal and external resources.

items.title: Budget
items.text: Sequence, efforts, timeline and costs, technology choices.

items.title: Activate
items.text: Resource allocation, project launch, change management, communication, and continuous feedback.
